title: Birdie
description: Birdie is an exploration of a novel sensory experience as a first step towards a true flying experience. With the use of a tele-existence concept an augmented human controls an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) remotely. At the same time he or she receives multi sensory feedback like vision and sound from the UAV.

publications.title: Birdie: Towards a true flying experience
publications.citation: Petry, B., Ortega-Avila, S., Nanayakkara, S.C., and Foong, S., 2014, Birdie: Towards a true flying experience. In Workshop on Assistive Augmentation, Extended Abstracts of the 32nd Annual SIGCHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI14). Toronto, Canada.
